rationale: Best channel should be mostly a function of the budget composition (n_identity, n_labels), which the scalar summary (mean/variance/MI of T) does not encode -- the witness shows exact non-identifiability. So a fitted summary-only rule should retain a substantial gap, budget knowledge should be near-sufficient, and the shape-based point values (which encode budgets through the posterior) should be mostly right, with FMoW's selected-state failure possibly visible as a higher model-pick error there.
practitioner_threshold: relative gap >= 10% of the state's initial squared error
falsified_if: belief-only gap is indistinguishable from budget-only (summary as good as knowing what you acquired), or model-pick error exceeds belief-only
